description: This file defines the 'Tracing' class, which manages tracing operations such as starting, stopping, grouping, and collecting stack traces within the Playwright core library. It handles trace artifacts, file saving, and interaction with external channels and utilities.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class that manages tracing sessions, including starting, stopping, grouping, and saving trace data, with support for chunked traces and artifact handling.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Tracing instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Tracing object with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new tracing session with optional parameters like name, title, snapshots, screenshots, sources, and live mode.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk with optional name and title.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group with a specified name and optional source location.

methods.name: _startCollectingStacks
methods.description: Begins collecting stack traces for the current trace, setting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally saving to a specified file path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracing session and finalizes the trace, optionally saving to a file.

methods.name: _doStopChunk
methods.description: Handles the logic for stopping a trace chunk, including artifact saving and cleanup.
